papers.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
papers.abstract: A benchmark of 46 long-horizon tasks spanning nine categories evaluates AI agents through fine-grained graded subtasks. Tasks require hundreds of episodes and minutes to hours of execution, revealing significant headroom for improvement in agent capabilities.

papers.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
papers.abstract: Large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pre-training paradigm for computer vision. GenCeption leverages a pre-trained video generative diffusion backbone for various vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance across depth, surface normal, camera pose estimation, and other benchmarks.

papers.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
papers.abstract: Visual pretraining on documents and web pages outperforms text-only pretraining for foundation models. Rich visual information from figures, equations, and layouts carries knowledge that cannot be fully captured by text extraction alone.

papers.title: Trust Region Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Transforms unstable on-policy distillation into a stable training paradigm through dynamic proximal teacher construction. Dramatically enhances training stability and sample efficiency on mathematical reasoning tasks with zero additional computational overhead.

papers.title: KronQ: LLM Quantization via Kronecker-Factored Hessian
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization framework incorporating gradient covariance into quantization pipelines. KronQ achieves 7.93 perplexity on 2-bit weight-only quantization for LLaMA-3-70B, significantly outperforming existing methods like GPTQ.

papers.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
papers.abstract: Comparative study of softmax attention and four recurrent linear-attention architectures. Kimi Delta Attention with Muon optimizer reaches lowest validation loss, while Cross-Layer Value Routing yields modest improvements over matched baselines.

papers.title: From RGB Generation to Dense Field Readout: Pixel-Space Dense Prediction with Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract: Adapts pretrained text-to-image models for dense prediction by mapping tokens to task-native outputs rather than generating RGB images. Sets new state-of-the-art on trimap-free matting, KITTI depth, and referring segmentation benchmarks.

papers.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
papers.abstract: Formalizes the 'Knowing-Using Gap' where LLMs memorize facts but fail at reasoning. Uses self-patching intervention technique to identify activation locations where knowledge routing fails, recovering 58-75% of oracle generalization headroom.

papers.title: Self-Guided Test-Time Training for Long-Context LLMs
papers.abstract: Proposes Self-Guided TTT method where models identify evidence spans before adaptation. Achieves up to 15% relative improvement on LongBench-v2 and LongBench-Pro benchmarks for both Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct models.

papers.title: PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation
papers.abstract: Addresses long-range memory in panoramic world models by exploiting rotation-equivariant properties. Introduces World360 dataset with real-world and simulated panoramic video clips for evaluating physical consistency under diverse conditions.

cc_updates.body: Auto mode is now available without CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE opt-in on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry; disable via disableAutoMode in settings. Fixed the terminal freezing and keystrokes lagging while streaming responses containing very long lists, tables, paragraphs, or code blocks. Fixed remote managed settings from a non-interactive run being permanently recorded as consented without showing the security consent dialog. Fixed spurious prompt-injection warnings triggered by benign system-generated conversation updates. Fixed the auto-updater overwriting a custom launcher script or symlink at ~/.local/bin/claude on every release.

Added directory path suggestions to /cd, matching /add-dir behavior. Added a /doctor check that proposes trimming checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content Claude could derive from the codebase. /commit-push-pr now auto-allows git push to the repo configured push remote. Gateway: /login now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints. Background agents now upgrade to a new version in the background right after a Claude Code update, instead of paying a slow stale-session upgrade when you attach.

Added an auto mode rule that blocks tampering with session transcript files. Fixed --json-schema silently producing unstructured output when the schema was invalid, and schemas using the format keyword being rejected. Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being silently lost when the turn ended at the --max-turns limit. Fixed Windows worktree removal deleting files outside the worktree when an NTFS junction or directory symlink existed inside it. Fixed background agents staying shown as failed or completed in the agent list after being resumed with SendMessage.
